description: Scenario tests for thread-writer. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-thread
evals.input: Write an X thread about how we cut our churn in half.
expect: reads brand-profile and voice first
opens with a post that hooks AND promises the payoff, and stands alone
makes one cohesive idea with a clear spine, one beat per post
every post front-loads its point and pulls forward (no filler)
closes by landing the payoff with exactly one CTA (e.g., reshare the opener)

evals.name: opener-hooks-and-promises
evals.input: Give me the first tweet for a thread about our launch.
expect: the opener uses a real hook mechanism (via hook-writer)
it also promises what the thread delivers
it works as a standalone, reshareable post — not just setup for post 2
no slow wind-up or 'a thread:' with no hook

evals.name: one-idea-not-chopped-article
evals.input: Turn this blog post into a thread.
expect: atomizes the idea and rebuilds a native thread rather than slicing the article into chunks
the thread has one cohesive through-line, one beat per post
does NOT produce arbitrarily split paragraphs with no flow

evals.name: each-post-earns-the-next
evals.input: Write a thread on our 7 onboarding lessons.
expect: each post delivers a distinct beat and pulls forward
cuts filler posts; every post earns its place
uses numbering/transitions to maintain momentum

evals.name: when-not-to-thread
evals.input: Make a thread out of this: 'consistency beats volume.'
expect: recognizes a single sharp take with no sub-beats
recommends a single strong post instead of padding a thread
does NOT manufacture filler posts to force a thread

evals.name: platform-adaptation
evals.input: Write this as a thread for Threads, not X.
expect: adapts to Threads mechanics (looser register, ~500 char posts, lighter numbering, one tag)
does not blindly apply X conventions (heavy numbering, RT-opener) where they don't fit
keeps the brand voice

evals.name: reads-voice
evals.input: Write a thread about our pricing change.
evals.context: voice.md bans exclamation marks and hype words.
expect: every post is in the brand voice with no exclamation marks or banned words
the register is conversational/native to the platform
the opener doesn't open with 'We're excited to announce'

evals.name: close-and-growth-mechanic
evals.input: Write a thread to grow my following.
expect: the close lands the payoff rather than trailing off
uses exactly one CTA
leverages the reshare-the-opener growth move on X (in voice)
any link is placed to avoid dampening reach (reply or final post)
